title.zh: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30
title.en: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30

current_state.zh: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.
current_state.en: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.
